record.question: Which of the following are the consequences of vitamin and mineral deficiencies which can lead to dementia and memory disorders in alcohol abuse?
record.explanation: Answer B: Korsakoff's syndrome. Thiamine deficiency in chronic alcohol use can cause Wernicke–Korsakoff syndrome; Korsakoff syndrome is marked by severe memory impairment. Reference: https://www.niaaa.nih.gov/publications/brochures-and-fact-sheets/alcohol-and-brain. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
